'''D9-28''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] as part of a survey team to [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress (Third Galactic War)|investigate]] the wreckage of [[Darth Malgus]]'s [[Emperor's Fortress|space station]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]<ref name="Dark Heart of the Fortress" /> around [[3623 BBY]].<ref name="Death" /> D9-28 was [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] during the mission, but its log records remained intact. Later, the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Lana Beniko]] reviewed the log records and played a recording from just before the droid's destruction.<ref name="Dark Heart of the Fortress" />
